description: Source code for thread information handling in breakpad, including CPU context filling and register access for various architectures.

classes.name: ThreadInfo
classes.description: Class providing thread context information and register access for different CPU architectures.

methods.name: GetInstructionPointer
methods.description: Returns the instruction pointer for the thread based on architecture.

methods.name: FillCPUContext
methods.description: Fills a RawContextCPU structure with the thread's CPU register state.

methods.name: GetGeneralPurposeRegisters
methods.description: Provides access to the general purpose registers and their size.

methods.name: GetFloatingPointRegisters
methods.description: Provides access to the floating point registers and their size.
